_about: Paper the game draws itself in Tsukumodō (crates/game/src/paper.rs): where it hangs, in the building's Blender frame (x across the frontage, y towards the street, z up; metres) and which way it faces (yaw degrees about z; 0 faces -Y, 180 faces the street).
